Based in [[Buenos Aires]], the '''Instituto Argentino de Matemática''' (I. A. M.) <ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.iam-conicet.gov.ar|title=Instituto Argentino de Matemática|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> is a research center of the National Research Council of Argentina ([[CONICET]]). It is named after [[Alberto Pedro Calderón]] in honor of one of its former directors, the Argentinian mathematician widely recognized as a towering figure of 20th-century mathematics. The overarching goal of the institute is to promote the development of pure and applied mathematics research in [[Argentina]].
